title: Santa Fe
description: Three brothers become outlaws after the Civil War, while a fourth sibling goes to work for the railroad.

title: The Thrill Hunter
description: After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.

title: The Return of Daniel Boone
description: The scout's grandson (Bill Elliott) foils land-grabbers; his sidekick (Dub Taylor) flirts with twins.

title: Massacre Canyon
description: A cavalry officer and two of his men set out to make sure that a shipment of guns safely reaches its destination.

title: Mackenna's Gold
description: Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.

title: A Lawless Street
description: The wife (Angela Lansbury) of a roving marshal (Randolph Scott) wants him to quit, but first he has to clean up Medicine Bend.

title: The Nevadan
description: An undercover U.S. marshal (Randolph Scott) and a crooked rancher follow an outlaw (Forrest Tucker) to stolen gold.

title: Hangman's Knot
description: A Confederate (Randolph Scott) and his men rob Union gold in Nevada, then learn the war's been over for a month.

title: Jubal
description: A Wyoming rancher's (Ernest Borgnine) wife eyes a drifter (Glenn Ford), and her ex-lover (Rod Steiger) tells her husband.

title: The Texas Rangers
description: The fastest gun (George Montgomery) in Texas is let out of prison to help the Rangers stop a gang of outlaws.

title: The Blazing Trail
description: A worthless gold mine leads the Durango Kid and a newspaperman on a trail marked by suspicion and deceit.

title: King of the Wild Horses
description: A mustang stallion runs swiftly to the rescue when the boy who befriended him is endangered.

title: Cowboy
description: A Chicago hotel desk clerk (Jack Lemmon) talks a trail boss (Glenn Ford) into taking him on a cattle drive to Mexico.

title: Western Code
description: Tim Barrett, a renowned lawman, rescues Patty from a ruffian and saves her brother from being lynched.

title: Jack McCall, Desperado
description: During the Civil War, a Southerner joins the Union Army and is accused of leaking information to the Confederates.

title: Relentless
description: Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.

title: Land Raiders
description: An Arizona land-grabber (Telly Savalas) and his brother (George Maharis) renew their feud amid Army troops and Apaches.

title: Reprisal!
description: An Indian girl (Kathryn Grant) and a land agent's daughter (Felicia Farr) save a part-Indian cattle rancher (Guy Madison) from vigilantes.

title: The Parson and the Outlaw
description: Pretending death at the hands of Marshal Garrett, Billy the Kid rides away to live in peace under a new name.

title: Ambush at Tomahawk Gap
description: Flaming arrows stop four ex-convicts searching a ghost town for their buried loot.

title: Stage to Tucson
description: Troubleshooters track Arizona stagecoaches hijacked for sale to the Confederacy.

title: The Law vs. Billy the Kid
description: Outlaw Billy (Scott Brady) courts a rancher's daughter (Betta St. John) and is hunted by lawman Pat Garrett (James Griffith).

title: The Quick Gun
description: A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.

title: The Prescott Kid
description: A cowboy finds himself in serious trouble with a notorious outlaw.

title: Renegades
description: The girlfriend (Evelyn Keyes) of a frontier doctor (Willard Parker) falls for a member (Larry Parks) of an outlaw clan.

title: Coroner Creek
description: A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.

title: The Man From Colorado
description: A homicidal Civil War colonel (Glenn Ford) turns federal judge, with his former aide as marshal (William Holden).

title: The Hard Man
description: A Texas Ranger (Guy Madison) turns deputy sheriff; a woman (Valerie French) wants him to kill her cattle-baron husband (Lorne Greene).

title: Forbidden Trail
description: A practical-joking cowboy (Buck Jones) gets serious with outlaws.

title: The Pathfinder
description: A British scout (Kevin Dillon) infiltrates a French stronghold near the Great Lakes during the 1750s.

title: Utah Blaine
description: A gunfighter helps a ranch owner in his attempt to prevent a renegade crew from taking over the territory.

title: Indian Uprising
description: Gold thieves and the government rile Geronimo, despite a cavalry captain's (George Montgomery) efforts at peace.

title: Count Three and Pray
description: A preacher (Van Heflin) with a reckless past rebuilds a church after the Civil War with a teenage girl (Joanne Woodward) from the hills.

title: Montana Territory
description: A cowgirl vigilante (Wanda Hendrix) proves to a deputy (Lon McCallister) that the sheriff (Preston Foster) is an outlaw.

title: Unknown Valley
description: Joe goes looking for his missing father in the desert, then strange villagers take him captive; he finds his father and plans to escape, taking with him a woman that he has fallen for.

title: The Last Posse

title: The Stranger Wore a Gun
description: A man whose life was saved by an outlaw shows his gratitude by reluctantly assisting in a stagecoach robbery.

title: Men Without Law
description: Returning from the war, Buck gets caught by Murdock, who takes his letter of introduction to the Del Reys. Posing as Buck, Murdock takes Del Ray's jewels and his daughter Jaunita. To rescue Juanita, Buck poses as Murdock.
